item.title: 23 Herricks students receive Regional Scholastic Writing Awards

item.title: Court filing reveals new details in Gilgo Beach serial killer case
item.description: Accused Gilgo Beach serial killer Rex Heuermann contacted dozens of sex workers hundreds of times in the years before he was arrested for allegedly murdering seven women, prosecutors revealed in court filings.
